Variable Details

  • obs time (Observation Time):
    The time when observed water level exceeded official threshold.
  • sim time (Simulation Time):
    The time when simulated discharge exceeded 2 year return period.
  • Hydrographs (Image):
    Time series observed water level data and simulated discharge are shown.
